youtube.title: Day One. Again. (Starting Over Is Not Starting From Zero)
youtube.description:
This is his ninth day one.
He hung a calendar on the wall and drew one small line. Two days. Three. Then a bad day at work, a party, a phone call, and every time, the same red line through the same small number.
After forty days, he fell again. He ripped the calendar off the wall.

Then, for the first time, he laid the torn pages side by side.

Every run was longer than the one before. He hadn't been failing. He had been climbing.
If today is your day one again: starting over is not starting from zero. Keep going.

Until he laid the torn pages side by side, and saw that every run was longer than the one before.

He hadn't been failing. He had been climbing.
If today is your day one again: starting over is not starting from zero. Keep going.
